lines.text: Every synthesizer has a sound in it that's yours. Finding it is the hard part.
Auracle is a synthesizer that searches for your sound.
Play. Pick what you like. It learns your taste, and grows new patches toward it: real modular circuits, not samples.
Turn Bright, and it finds the knobs that make this patch brighter.
Press Offer, and a new version grows from the sound in your hands.
Each named control is a direction in a 44-dimensional space of what you hear, wired to this patch's knobs by its measured Jacobian.
Under the hood: a Bayesian posterior over your taste, and evolution as inference, written in Rust and running in your browser as WASM.
Every sound in this film is Auracle. Play it in your browser today.
